subject: Post-call: Lighthouse rotation proposal for multi-zone deep-dive
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@meditech.com>, Ana Gómez <ana.gomez@salushealth.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 05 May 2028 22:10:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: Lighthouse rotation proposal for multi-zone deep-dive

Hi Sanjay / Ana —

Thanks again for a great discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next step:

Recap
- Core goal: validate performance & cost profile for a 2–3 model inference path in our environment, and run a short tech deep-dive for the engineering team.
- Key constraints: mixed US/EU/APAC stakeholders, strict audit window (SOC2 evidence required), and a short pilot timeline (2–3 weeks).

Next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive (team with infra + security + engineering). Given the geography, I want to propose a rotating weekly window so the same stakeholders can join across timezones without repeatedly moving calendars.

Proposed rotation (3-week cycle) — idea in brief:
Week A (US-friendly): 08:00–10:00 PDT (11:00–13:00 EDT)
Week B (EU-friendly): 15:00–17:00 CET (09:00–11:00 EDT)
Week C (APAC-friendly): 09:00–11:00 SGT / AEST

Operational notes:
- Each week we run one deep-dive with the full panel and a short asynchronous recording + notes for those who can’t attend.
- We’ll rotate the host/technical lead from Redwood so preload and handoff are cleaner.
- Attached: redwood-lighthouse-rotation-playbook (short playbook + sample agenda) and an .ics with the 3 template windows.

Ask: Can you share which of the three weeks (A/B/C) aligns best with Salus’ cross-functional calendar for late May/early June? If helpful, provide two preferred dates per week and I’ll send a rotating invite that we can accept/decline.

If you prefer a different cadence (e.g., two-week rotation or fixed time), we can adapt — this is a first pass to avoid repeated rescheduling.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood-lighthouse-rotation-playbook.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)
Attachment: proposed-3-week-rotation.ics (calendar template)

From: Ana Gómez <ana.gomez@salushealth.io>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@meditech.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Team Scheduling <scheduling@salushealth.io>
Date: Sun, 06 May 2028 02:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: Lighthouse rotation proposal for multi-zone deep-dive

Thanks Michael — nice summary.

Salus is +1 on the rotating approach. A couple notes from our side:
- Preferred cadence: 3-week rotation works best (gives our EU engineers time to align).
- Availability constraints: our security lead (Sanjay) is generally only available Tue/Thu afternoons CET. Our APAC SRE team prefers mornings SGT.
- For pilot timeline: can we target the first deep-dive last week of May (May 29–31 window) and then rotate the following two weeks?

Concrete ask:
- Can you propose two concrete slots for Week A (US-friendly) in the May 29–31 window that are also friendly to at least one EU participant? If not, we’ll surface alternatives.

We’ll follow up from scheduling@salushealth.io with calendar conflicts once you send the invites.

Thanks — Ana
Ana Gómez
Director of Engineering, Salus Health
ana.gomez@salushealth.io

Subject: Re: Post-call: Lighthouse rotation proposal for multi-zone deep-dive

Great — thanks Ana, that timing works. Per your request, two concrete Week A slots (US-friendly) within May 29–31 that still allow EU participation: 
Option 1: Tue, May 30 — 15:00 UTC (08:00 PDT / 11:00 EDT / 16:00 CEST) — 90 min
Option 2: Wed, May 31 — 16:00 UTC (09:00 PDT / 12:00 EDT / 17:00 CEST) — 90 min

Both of these hit late morning US / mid-afternoon EU. If Sanjay can do Tue/Thu afternoons CET I flagged Option 1 as preferable (falls on Tue CET afternoon).

Operational ask:
- Camila, can you be the technical host for Option 1? If yes I’ll draft the invite and include the agenda + the short list of pre-reads (attached playbook).
- Scheduling@salushealth, can you confirm which of the two options (or alternatives) we should place on the calendar? We’ll treat it as tentative until accepted.

If I don’t hear back by EOD tomorrow PDT I’ll tentatively book Option 1 and send an invite marked 'tentative — please confirm'.

Thanks —
Michael

I can host Option 1 (Tue, May 30 — 15:00 UTC). I’ll prepare a lightweight agenda:
- 0–10 min: introductions & objectives
- 10–30 min: infra & latency/cost targets (live demo of 2-model flow)
- 30–65 min: integration Q&A + SOC2 evidence mapping (security)
- 65–90 min: next steps & pilot checklist

I’ll attach a short runbook and sample curl commands for the team to try before the call. Michael — please send the tentative invite and I’ll add the runbook to the invite materials.

—
Camila Reyes
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai
